summary: Iteration 3 (In-app chat, Mark as rented, Virtual tour video upload, Share) fully verified. Backend: 12/12 new pytest cases pass on the public URL covering (a) POST /api/conversations — fresh tenant without offer → 403, tenant with accepted offer opens idempotent conversation (same conversation_id on repeat), owner with tenant_id who made an offer → 200, owner with tenant_id who never made an offer → 403, owner missing tenant_id → 400; (b) GET /api/conversations returns for both parties with 'other', 'listing', 'unread' decorators, GET /api/conversations/{id} returns 404 to a third party (spec allowed 403 or 404), POST /api/conversations/{id}/messages persists, GET messages marks read (per-conversation unread flips to 0), empty text → 422; (c) PATCH /api/listings/{id} status='rented' — 403 for tenant, 200 for owner, listing disappears from public GET /api/listings but is still visible with mine=true and owner_id filter, GET /api/listings/{id} shows status='rented', a pending offer on the listing flips to 'closed', new POST offer on rented listing → 409, status='available' relists it; PATCH video field persists then clears; (d) POST /api/upload with a tiny video/mp4 blob returns {path,url} ending .mp4 and GET /api/files/{path} serves the exact bytes with content-type video/*. Frontend (Expo web 390x844): owner login → Activity → activity-inbox-button (with unread badge) → inbox-screen → 2 conversation rows → chat-screen entered, chat-input + chat-send-button creates a message bubble with testID message-msg_*. Listing detail (owner) — listing-share-button opens WhatsApp popup (web fallback wa.me URL with prefilled text, no crash), 15 offer-message-* buttons on the seed Lekki listing each open chat-screen, listing-mark-rented-button flips detail to show listing-rented-pill + listing-rented-banner + listing-relist-button, and listing-relist-button restores the mark-rented CTA (verified round-trip). Tenant login → Activity shows my-offer-chat-<id> 'Message homeowner' button on accepted offer cards (7 present); tapping opens chat-screen with the owner's earlier message rendered. Explore shows only available listings (5 seed cards, no rented ones). Create Listing screen renders add-video-button and the Virtual tour hint. Line-art backdrops on saved/profile/create render without overflow. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch not present — the virtual tour uses expo-video). Minor: the WhatsApp share URL contains %EF%BF%BD (U+FFFD replacement char) instead of the two emojis in shareText — see /app/frontend/src/share.ts:10. Doesn't crash but breaks the emoji.

ui_bugs.issue: The wa.me URL contains %EF%BF%BD (U+FFFD replacement char) where the 🏠 and 📍 emojis in buildShareText should be — checked via popup.url in Playwright. Likely a UTF-8 → Latin1 conversion on the way to encodeURIComponent. Reference: /app/frontend/src/share.ts:10

action_items: (LOW) Fix emoji encoding in /app/frontend/src/share.ts:buildShareText — the 🏠 and 📍 characters end up as U+FFFD in the wa.me URL on web. Reproduces by clicking listing-share-button as owner and inspecting the popup URL. Consider building the text as a plain string and letting encodeURIComponent handle it (already used inside share.ts) — verify the source string isn't being latin-1 decoded somewhere upstream (maybe React Native web's Share polyfill).

(Cleanup, non-blocking) Iteration 3 tests created a handful of TEST_* fresh homeowners/tenants via /api/auth/register and a few TEST_ prefixed offers on the Lekki listing. Listing was relisted back to 'available' at the end of every rent test — no listings left in rented state.
(Optional) GET /api/conversations/{id} returns 404 (not 403) for a non-participant reader. The review request allowed either, but 403 would be more informative. Not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: decorate_conversation issues 2 queries per conversation (other user + listing) plus a count_documents for unread — GET /api/conversations/unread runs decorate_conversation for every conversation solely to sum unread. For a mailbox with N conversations this is O(3N) round-trips; consider a single $lookup + $group aggregation once inboxes grow. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:929-935.

POST /api/conversations/{id}/messages does not enforce that the sender is still allowed to chat (e.g. after the listing goes to 'rented' the owner may still legitimately chat, but there's no check that the underlying accepted offer wasn't declined afterwards). Currently anyone in the conversation membership can keep messaging forever — probably intentional but worth documenting.

The /api/upload video path allows any mp4/mov/m4v/webm up to 50MB without transcoding or thumbnail extraction — Expo VideoTour renders whatever the owner uploaded. Consider server-side ffprobe/duration validation (spec caps at 60s) and thumbnail generation for the detail screen.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested critical flows (owner chat/share/rent/relist, tenant inbox+chat, create-listing add-video-button, line-art screens)

seed_data_creation: Registered ~2-3 throwaway TEST_ homeowners / tenants via /api/auth/register (used for the negative-case fresh users). Created ~4 TEST_ prefixed offers on seed listings; the Lekki listing was toggled to 'rented' and then back to 'available' twice (final state: available). Two new conversations were created between owner and tenant (idempotent path exercised).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://direct-housing-2.preview.emergentagent.com. Web preview: Expo tab role 'Activity/Explore/Saved/Profile' is not exposed as ARIA role='tab' — use direct URL navigation (page.goto('/activity'), '/saved', '/profile') or click by text/href instead of get_by_role('tab'). Chat inbox unread badge is inside the activity-inbox-button and not a separate testID — read the button's textContent to assert the number. Conversations have 15+ offer-message-* buttons on the seed Lekki listing because prior iterations produced many test offers; when the owner opens chat with a tenant who already has a conversation, the conversation is reused (idempotent). Owner can force-rent + relist a seed listing safely — pending offers flip to 'closed' and stay closed after relist (accepted offers are untouched). Tests avoid leaving rented state at teardown. Video upload uses multipart on /api/upload; you must strip 'Content-Type: application/json' from the auth header dict before calling requests.post(files=...) or the boundary won't be set.
rca_of_issue: Share emoji bug: buildShareText interpolates 🏠 and 📍 into a template string then passes to `Share.share({message})` on native, and to `navigator.share`/wa.me on web. When the wa.me fallback builds `https://api.whatsapp.com/send?text=${encodeURIComponent(shareText)}`, the resulting query already shows %EF%BF%BD. The most likely cause is the shareText being read from a source whose file/string encoding lost the 4-byte UTF-8 sequences (e.g. transpiled via a step that treats source as latin-1). Repro: on web preview, login as owner@renter.app, open any listing, click listing-share-button, then read popup.url — you'll see %EF%BF%BD in place of both emojis. Mitigation: replace the emojis with plain unicode escapes ('\u{1F3E0}' and '\u{1F4CD}') in /app/frontend/src/share.ts, or remove them entirely.
